summary_md: **HiMorishige ([@_himorishige](https://x.com/_himorishige/status/2116475517746684196))** reports **NVIDIA Sync 0.148.0** adds a beta Model Launcher that installs a model (default Qwen3.8 27B NVFP4), vLLM and the OpenCode agent on DGX Spark and starts/stops them from a GUI across 1–4 units; he warns LAN exposure is unencrypted HTTP ([NVIDIA Sync docs](https://docs.nvidia.com/sync/latest/models.html)).
